messages:
jamie: Heads-up — seeing a 12-18% tail latency spike on host nodes during today's 09:13 mini-burst replay. profiler points to the preemptive-parse path causing KV cache fallthrough + extra grpc writev churn. cc @vijay @lina :eyes:

vijay: Can you dump the flamegraph / perf summary?

jamie: perf summary attached (quick): top stacks: preparse_tokenizer (22%), kvcache::evict_if_needed (17%), grpc_writev (13%). Flamegraph: https://perf.internal/graphs/1830000000 — notable spike at parse->kv miss boundary.

lina: Hit rate numbers? Are we actually spilling or just evicting more often?

jamie: kvcache hit rate dropped from ~98% baseline to ~72% during the burst window. No disk spill but more evict cycles and repeated key lookups. Kernel chooser logs show frequent flip short_seq->long_seq because fragmented frames increase perceived seq length.

nate: Hypothesis: preemptive parse is producing many tiny frames which pushes keys out of hot shard; that plus batching heuristics picks smaller batches and forces kernel switches. Experiments to try:
- disable preparse on grpc path
- bump batching_hint to favor larger micro-batches for mini-bursts
- force short-seq kernel to be more tolerant

vijay: Can you paste the quick config snippet you want to try?

jamie: Sure — planning a one-node canary with this tweak:

```
--runtime.preparse.grpc=false
--runtime.batch_hint=aggressive_small
--runtime.kernel.cutoff_short_seq=80  # was 64
```

nate: Also worth trying replay with different HTTP2 window sizes — fragmentation looks suspicious. Compare SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE=65535 vs 32768. Smaller window => more frames => worse.

lina: Good call. Add a microbench to measure writev ops per second and kvcache hit-rate across window sizes. Suggest commands: 

```
tools/replay-mini-burst --trace=grpc --window=65535 --out=/tmp/run-65535.trace
tools/replay-mini-burst --trace=grpc --window=32768 --out=/tmp/run-32768.trace
perf-collect --pid <svc> --out flame-*.svg
```

vijay: If kernel chooser is misclassifying, tighten the selector threshold but add telemetry: log kernel_choice_reason and seq_len distribution for 10k requests. If we fix, create regression alert on kvcache-hitrate delta > 5% during bursts.

jamie: Rolling the canary now (preparse off + batch_hint + cutoff_short_seq=80) on host-pool-7. Will run the replay suite.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to host-pool-7 (commit abc123) :white_check_mark:

perf-bot: perf job queued: replay-mini-burst -> /artifacts/1830000000/results.json

lina: If this reduces tail, follow-up: update kernel selection tests and add a synthetic with controlled fragmentation to CI.

nate: If it doesn't, next step: instrument kvcache to record per-request key residency time and try shard-level reservation for bursty keys.

jamie: Thanks — I'll post numbers in ~30m. :thumbsup:
